svg.aria-label: EchoMind V2 domain entity-relationship diagram for the memory reasoning pipeline
svg.text: Invariants that make the model auditable
Relation: closed kind vocabulary · non-empty subject/object/rule · frozen/slotted · provenance facts · no confidence.
Spatial degradation is first-class: resolve_zone → location, resolve_camera → source, and degraded/fallback are carried on the relation.
ContextItem carries two thresholds (signal ≥ 2, narratable ≥ 3); nothing is deleted, low-salience relations are demoted, not hidden.
